summary: This bundle is accurate on everything that drives profitability. All 4-bed and 5-6-bed 905/915 rates (full and 90% base) match the DDS 'Rates Effective Jul 2026' xlsx files exactly. So do the tier groupings, checked against 18 regional center files (SDRC=HRC=RCOC=NLACRC=SGPRC=NBRC; CVRC=ACRC=FNRC=IRC=KRC=RCRC=VMRC; RCEB=SARC; GGRC $15,309.57). The $1,444.07 B&C / $182 P&I matches the DDS rate page and ACWDL 25-29 ($1,626.07 NMOHC minus $182). Rate-model staffing hours (180/220/300/280 for 5+ beds), wages ($18.20/$19.58/$25.24), consultant hours (16/24/32 per year at $123.50), mileage (210 x $0.725) and food ($270) match the Feb 2026 Burns rate models. Other verified figures: Title 17 staffing/consultant tables (56004), 56005, 56026, 56037, 56038, 56033, 54320, 54326; Title 22 85018, 85064, 85064.2/.3, 85065.5/.6, 85087, 85088, 80020; HSC 1523.1 fees ($908/$454), 1566.2, 1520.5; CAB 90-120 days and contacts; admin cert $100/$140/35 hrs/40 CE; Component I $54.85; FTB $800 plus fee tiers; minimum wages ($16.90; SD $17.75; SJ $18.45; LA City $18.42; SF $19.61); the WCIRB $1.65 benchmark; HUD FY26 4-BR FMRs; DDS caseload/POS figures; every CHHS residence/age count; the CCL ARF counts (6,128 licensed / 40,041 beds, capacity buckets, counties, 512 new / 360 closed in 2024); and the DSTF FY17-18 level counts. I recomputed the model and it reproduces exactly: arf4x2_l6 +5,229 (0.844), arf4_l6 +2,698 (0.842), arf6_l4 +828 (0.882), arf4_l4 -1,730 (0.952), arf4_l3 -2,223 (0.979). Staffing at the DDS hours with 24/7 awake coverage meets 17 CCR 56004(c) and 22 CCR 85065.5/85065.6. Rent is fixed, and the LLC fee is correctly sized per configuration. Issues found: one wrong sensitivity number (1.15 paid-hours factor), a dead USDA URL, citation and labeling fixes, and a missing local-wage and independent-review caveat. Not re-confirmed: the BLS 21-1093 and 11-9151 25th-percentile values, because the BLS API hit its daily limit and the cited page is now an index.

Other configurations at 1.15: arf4x2_l6 −260; arf6_l4 −1,901; arf4_l4 −3,700; arf4_l3 −3,805. Hand check: (1009.8×18.20 + 253.6×19.58) × (1.15/1.045 − 1) × 1.17 = $2,745. At DDS's own productivity factor the default home is slightly negative, not slightly positive.

issues.current: arf4_l3 override = 164.67 (16 hrs/yr) and arf4_l6 / arf4x2_l6 overrides = 329.33 (32 hrs/yr), all under an item label that says 'Level 4 (24 hrs/resident/yr)'
issues.correct: Item label without a level/hours (e.g., 'Consultant hours (behavioral/clinical)'), with the hours stated in each override's notes
issues.evidence: The values are right: the DDS rate models fund 16 consultant hrs/yr at Level 3, 24 at Level 4 and 32 at Level 6. 17 CCR 56004(f) requires 4A/4B 8, 4C 8, 4D–4E 12, 4F 12 and 4G–4I 16 hrs per six months. But the shared label prints 'Level 4 (24 hrs)' on the Level 3 and Level 6 P&Ls. Overrides match by exact name, so the label must change in the base item and in every override together.
issues.fix: Rename the base opex item and all three overrides to 'Consultant hours (behavioral/clinical)'. Put 'L3: 16 hrs/yr', 'L4: 24 hrs/yr' and 'L6 (4I): 32 hrs/yr × $123.50' in the notes.

issues.current: No independent-review cost for the single 4-bed Level 6 home
issues.correct: Note that regional center payments cross $500,000/yr above about 93.9% occupancy, or with the QIP, which triggers a WIC §4652.5 independent review (operator estimate ≈ $500/month as used in arf4x2_l6)
issues.evidence: Regional center portion at 97% = $11,095.17 × 3.88 × 12 = $516,600/yr, which is at or above the $500,000 threshold in the RCOC notice ('more than or equal to five hundred thousand dollars ($500,000), but less than two million'). At the 90% default it is $479,300, under the threshold. With the QIP earned at 90% it is $11,928.70 × 3.6 × 12 = $515,300. The optimistic net (+$5,965) and the QIP sensitivity (+$7,136) leave this cost out.
issues.fix: In the arf4_l6 notes, risks #8 and the QIP sensitivity row, add: 'At ~94%+ occupancy or with the QIP, regional center payments exceed $500,000/yr and an independent review (~$6,000/yr, operator estimate) is required.' Optionally reduce the QIP row to +$6,636.
